crops.name: Sitka spruce

soil.index: Aim for P and K index 3 (Teagasc). Take a soil test every 4–5 years.

planting.window: Plant Nov–Mar (bare-root); grant schemes via DAFM Forestry Programme

conventional.lime: Lime to keep pH 4.0–6.0; apply ground limestone per soil test (typically 2.5–7.5 t/ha), ideally a few months before sowing.
conventional.manures: Account for slurry/FYM nutrients (Teagasc Green Book values) and stay within Nitrates Regulations limits (170 kg/ha organic N whole-farm; derogation rules apply).
conventional.timing: Apply P & K at or before sowing; split N to match crop demand. Observe closed periods for fertiliser and slurry.

organic.text: P at planting on poor peats only per forestry guidance.
organic.lime: Lime to keep pH 4.0–6.0; apply ground limestone per soil test (typically 2.5–7.5 t/ha), ideally a few months before sowing.

water.rainfall: Rain-fed; most conifers grow very well in Irish rainfall.

harvest.storage: Timber is sold standing or felled; follow forestry licence conditions.

conventional.pests: Large pine weevil (restocking), deer, hylobius, Dothistroma (pine), Phytophthora ramorum (larch).

organic.pests: Fallow restock sites, physical barriers/collars, deer fencing, species diversity.
organic.weeds: Mulch mats, manual weeding/trampling of bracken.

crops.rotation: 35–45 years (Sitka) to felling; felling licence required from DAFM.
